challenge.method: Read the complete LFT COPYING file, trace its package and retrieval scope, and inspect the Index decision for an exact digest and passage binding. Test whether the historical classification could apply to a different package version or later notice.
challenge.results: The LFT 3.91-2 file contains the 2007 VOSTROM Holdings, Inc. attribution, eight numbered conditions, and the final disclaimer. The Index row matches the subject, name, edition, notice, and recomputed full-file digest. The decision limits the historical assignment to the captured reference.

limitations: The Debian-hosted package artifact establishes the exact captured notice and its internal attribution. Direct publication by VOSTROM was outside the inspected retrieval route.
The 2007 date is an attribution in the notice. Later package versions and notices require separate references.
